text:
SRE_TriageBot: 🚨 Alert: realtime latency rule fired for /v1/generate — p95=420ms (baseline ~120ms), p99=1.8s. Detection window 5m. Graph: https://dash.redwoodinfra.internal/d/latency/realtime?panelId=7&from=now-15m IncidentID=INC-3865432100
Alice Chen: taking this — oncall Mateo, can you grab traces and check if this is global or region-specific?
Mateo Rivera: oncall here. seeing spike across us-west-2 and eu-west-1, us-east looks okay for now. opening traces quick: https://traces.redwood/internal/trace/3865432100
Mateo Rivera: quick checks:
- `kubectl get pods -n runtime | grep worker` shows a few CrashLoopBackOffs in us-west-2
- consumer lag for kv-cache-updates increased: `kc lag` -> 4200
- streaming connections in us-west-2 with huge tail latency (clients reporting stalls)
Alice Chen: CrashLoopBackOffs could explain session rebuilds. Carlos can you check node-level metrics (GPU saturations / host mem)?
Carlos Mendez: looking — GPU util in the affected cluster jumped to 92% on several nodes, GPU mem near full on two hosts. Not seeing OOMkilled, but scheduler is packing lots of long-stream jobs.
Priya Singh: from model side: recent rollout of quantized-gpt-large-qa2 in us-west-2 started 22m ago. It has slightly different KV cache behavior. Could be cache churn + larger attention causing stalls at tail. Reverting is an option.
SupportBot: alert: 3 support tickets flagged high latency for streaming endpoints, 1 enterprise customer (Acme Corp, app id: acme-88) is directly impacted.
Jules Park: adding — logs show repeated `KVCache miss` warnings for the quantized variant, plus many sessions reconnecting.
Mateo Rivera: mitigation idea: 1) divert 20% of traffic off quantized-gpt-large-qa2 to stable-gpt-large; 2) increase worker pool in us-west-2 from 40 -> 60; 3) enable prefix-KV cached responses at the proxy for hot routes. Which is lowest risk?
Priya Singh: diverting traffic is lowest risk. I can flip routing weight to stable model and monitor. Scaling workers is fine but may take 2-3 min to spin up. Cache toggles quick if proxy supports it.
Carlos Mendez: I'll scale workers now. `autoscaler set --pool runtime-usw2 --min 40 --max 100 --desired 60`
Carlos Mendez: scaling command issued. Pod churn expected ~90s.
Priya Singh: flipping routing: applying rollout patch:
```
PATCH /routing/service/v1
{ "route": "/v1/generate", "model_weights": { "quantized-gpt-large-qa2": 0.0, "stable-gpt-large": 1.0 }, "duration": "15m" }
```
Applying now.
Mateo Rivera: routing change applied. Observability: opening live tail on p95/p99 panel.
SRE_TriageBot: update: 3m after mitigation p95=210ms, p99=620ms. Trend downward but still above baseline.
Carlos Mendez: worker pool at desired 60, pods stabilized. GPU util now averaging 70% on scaled nodes.
Jules Park: streaming stalls reduced — fewer reconnects in logs. SupportBot: ACME ticket updated with message: "We identified and mitigated a streaming latency regression; responses should be returning to normal. We're monitoring."
Alice Chen: good. we should also capture why quantized variant caused KV thrash. Priya, can you capture a heaptrace/profile from one of the affected model containers and roll back the quantized rollout after capture?
Priya Singh: will capture profile. snapshot id: profile-3865432100-qual1. I'll keep the rollout paused in other regions.
Mateo Rivera: running a quick perf snapshot: `rt-run profile --container model-qa2 --duration 30s --out /tmp/profile.pb`
Mateo Rivera: also confirming no user-facing 5xxs observed, only timeouts and slow responses.
SRE_TriageBot: current metrics: p95=140ms, p99=380ms (10m after initial alert). Incident status: mitigated — monitoring.
Alice Chen: handing to follow-up list: - Priya to analyze profile and open bug for quantized rollout, - Carlos to run post-scaling host review, - Mateo to run 30m watch and create a short incident note. If metrics hold for 30m, we'll close.
SupportBot: note added to ACME ticket and broadcast to affected customers.
Jules Park: I'll collect the KVCache logs and push to the incident bucket: s3://ir-incident/INC-3865432100/kvcache.log
Alice Chen: thanks team. If anything regresses ping @oncall. I'll create an initial incident doc with timeline and mitigation commands.
Mateo Rivera: leaving monitoring on for next 45m. marking thread as watch. :eyes:
SRE_TriageBot: final update at +45m: p95 stable ~125ms, p99 ~180ms. Closing active paging. Recommend postmortem with root cause and a rollback guard for quantized model rollouts.
Alice Chen: agreed. I'll file the postmortem and link to this thread. Good job everyone. :tada:
